about_the_game:
BirdBalcony is a cozy desktop companion × narrative experience.

Your very own balcony stage comes alive as you feed, decorate, and watch the visitors it attracts.

🐦 Birds will bring you feathers and fragments of letters – notes, drafts, scribbles on the back of photos – slowly revealing stories and pieces of hidden worlds.

🌅 Each balcony style carries its own mood: the drifting anonymity of the city, salty seaside love letters, quiet countryside poems, and more.

✨ You never know who will visit your balcony next.

🎐 With time flowing – morning, day, dusk, and night – your desktop becomes a living, breathing space of calm and wonder.

Features

  • Desktop Companion: Runs as a pet on your desktop, adding warmth and presence to your everyday.

  • Feather Currency: Collect feathers dropped by visiting birds, and use them to unlock food, decorations, and story items.

  • Feeding System: Different foods attract different species – each with unique surprises.

  • Decoration System: Personalize each balcony with themed decorations, from Mediterranean rooftops to countryside fences.

  • Narrative Letters: Piece together fragmented letters to uncover intimate stories of solitude, memory, and connection.

  • Surprise Visitors: You never know if your next guest will be a sparrow, a dove… or something entirely unexpected.

  • Immersive Atmosphere: Time of day and weather affect which birds appear and what stories unfold.

  • Ongoing Expansion: Future DLC will introduce new balcony worlds, each with its own unique narrative.
